title: Puppet Master neutral source-control contracts
description: Backend-neutral repository, workspace, revision, writer-lease, credential-lease, setup, operation, receipt, projection, Backup source-closure, and restore-reconciliation contracts plus owner-DRY generic contracts for the nineteen canonical Source Control command request/result/error/availability/disabled-reason records and checkpoint permission decisions. Paths, focused UI state, newest records, remote text, and generic provider labels are descriptive and never identity authority. RepositoryForgeBinding remains repository-hosting authority; optional automation_binding_ref points to the independent Forge-owned AutomationBinding and never implies the same provider, instance, account, or host. Backup remains owner of BackupManifest, RestoreRun, staging, activation, and rollback; these records expose only Source Control closure and owner-route truth. Central catalog registration, native handlers, production wiring, Event Authority admission, remote calls, and runtime proof are outside this schema.

x-puppet-master-assertions: forge_instance_profile_ref resolves through the Forge owner and carries typed endpoint, trust, independent Git/API/Actions state, permission, and currentness facts without embedding credentials or certificate bytes
automation_binding_ref resolves to pm.forge.automation_binding.v1 and may name a different provider, instance, account, or host from forge_binding
absence of automation_binding_ref never disables ordinary source-control behavior, and no repository remote name or display label may synthesize one
repository.clone is the ordinary Git clone and requires scm_backend=git
return_context is echoed byte-for-byte by the terminal clone result
terminal clone result returns the initiating return_context exactly
cancelled clone leaves no registered Project and reports cleanup through result_refs

source_graph_projection.title: SourceGraph
source_graph_projection.description: A bounded, paginated, backend-native source-history projection. It is identity-bound presentation data, not repository identity authority, Jujutsu operation history, Backup history, a mutation command, or runtime proof.

backup_source_closure_record.title: BackupSourceClosureRecord
x-puppet-master-assertions: this record supplies Source Control closure truth and never owns backup bytes or BackupManifest
complete source history requires a barrier and GC/prune/rewrite fence held throughout capture
ordinary capture records credential-bearing mutable configuration as sanitized or blocked without rewriting immutable repository history
expected_event_types remains empty until Event Authority separately admits a producer and payload

backup_source_restore_reconciliation_rec.title: BackupSourceRestoreReconciliationReceipt
x-puppet-master-assertions: restore validation is isolated and does not activate content or write to a remote
restored remote and credential references remain non-authoritative until their owners revalidate identity trust scope and currentness
RepositoryForgeBinding and AutomationBinding remain separate and neither is inferred from a remote named origin
merge and rebind outcomes require backend-native receipts; collision conflict stale and effect-unknown states block activation
expected_event_types remains empty until Event Authority separately admits a producer and payload

x-backup-source-claim-boundary.owner_split: Backup owns BackupManifest RestoreRun staging activation rollback and recovery readiness; Source Control owns only source closure rebind merge remote-validation and backend receipt truth
x-backup-source-claim-boundary.command_effect: no new command or handler; existing owner commands retain handler_unavailable until independently proven
x-backup-source-claim-boundary.event_effect: expected_event_types=[]; receipt-only until Event Authority admits an exact producer payload retention redaction and consumer transaction
x-backup-source-claim-boundary.protected_data: raw keys tokens passwords cookies private key bytes auth URLs callback material protected-browser content credential-bearing paths and restored unsafe configuration are forbidden

cmd.source_control.checkpoint.restore.intended_semantics: Restore one exact backend-native checkpoint under writer lease, FileSafe, permission, topology, and revision fences.
